description: This file manages the state and logic for a chess game, including handling game initialization, moves, game status computation, and game state transitions via a reducer pattern. It also defines types for game mode and game state, and exposes functions for creating initial state, checking AI turn, and human player color.

methods.name: computeStatus(position)
methods.description: Determines the current game status (playing, checkmate, stalemate) based on the position.

methods.name: createInitialState(featureFlags)
methods.description: Creates the initial game state, optionally with AI enabled, using the standard chess starting position.

methods.name: computeLegalFromSelected(state)
methods.description: Computes legal moves from the selected square within the current game state.

methods.name: sameMove(a, b)
methods.description: Checks if two move objects are the same based on their from, to, and promotion fields.

methods.name: chessReducer(state, action)
methods.description: Handles state transitions based on dispatched game actions such as moves, undo, mode change, etc.

methods.name: isAiTurn(state)
methods.description: Returns true if it is currently the AI's turn to move based on game state and AI settings.

methods.name: humanColor(state)
methods.description: Returns the human player's color; when AI is enabled, it is the opposite of the AI's color.
